source: Your Pregnancy Week by Week — Glade B. Curtis and Judith Schuler

notes.summary: This is an exciting time for you—having a baby growing inside you is an incredible experience! Our goal is to help you understand and enjoy your pregnancy.
The beginning of a pregnancy is actually figured from the beginning of your last menstrual period. For your healthcare provider’s calculations, you are pregnant 2 weeks before you actually conceive!
The embryo is very small—at this point, it’s only a group of cells, but it’s growing rapidly.
Your developing baby’s size varies from 0.014 inch to about 0.04 inch (0.36mm to about 1mm) in length. One millimeter is half the size of a letter “o” on this page.
Your developing baby hasn’t grown a lot. By this week, it’s about 0.05 inch (1.25mm) long.
Crown-to-rump length is the sitting height or distance from the top of the baby’s head to its rump or buttocks.
Your baby goes through an incredible growth spurt around this time. At the beginning of this week, the crown-to-rump length is 0.16 to 0.2 inch (4 to 5mm), about the size of a BB pellet.
By this week of pregnancy, the crown-to-rump length of baby is ½ to ¾ inch (1.4 to 2cm). This is about the size of a pinto bean.
The crown-to-rump length of the embryo is 1 to 1¼ inches (2.2 to 3cm). This is close to the size of a medium green olive.
By this week, crown-to-rump length of baby is about 1¼ to 1¾ inches (3.1 to 4.2cm). Baby is starting to put on a little weight, so we’ll add weight in this section.
Crown-to-rump length of baby is 1½ to 2½ inches (4.4 to 6cm). Fetal weight is about 0.3 ounce (8g).
Your baby weighs between ⅓ and ½ ounce (8 to 14g), and crown-to- rump length is almost 2½ inches (6.1cm).
Your baby continues to grow rapidly! Its crown-to-rump length is 2½ to 3 inches (6.5 to 7.8cm), and it weighs between ½ and ¾ ounce (13 to 20g).
Crown-to-rump length is 3¼ to 4 inches (8 to 9.3cm). Your baby is about the size of your fist and weighs almost 1 ounce (25g).
The fetal crown-to-rump length by this week is 4 to 4½ inches (9.3 to 10.3cm). The fetus weighs about 1¾ ounces (50g).
Baby’s crown-to-rump length by this week is 4⅓ to 4⅔ inches (10.8 to 11.6cm). Weight is about 2¾ ounces (80g).
The crown-to-rump length of your baby is 4½ to 4¾ inches (11 to 12cm). Fetal weight has doubled in 2 weeks and is now about 3½ ounces (100g).
Baby’s crown-to-rump length is 5 to 5½ inches (12.5 to 14cm) by this week. Weight of the fetus is about 5¼ ounces (150g).
Crown-to-rump length of the growing fetus is 5¼ to 6 inches (13 to 15cm) by this week. Your baby weighs about 7 ounces (200g).
At this midpoint in your pregnancy, crown-to-rump length is 5⅔ to 6½ inches (14 to 16cm). Your baby weighs about 9 ounces (260g).
Your baby now weighs about 10½ ounces (300g); its crown-to-rump length is about 7¼ inches (18cm). It’s about the size of a large banana.
Your baby weighs about 12¼ ounces (350g). Crown-to-rump length at this time is about 7⅔ inches (19cm).
By this week, baby weighs almost 1 pound (455g)! Its crown-to-rump length is 8 inches (20cm).
By this week, baby weighs about 1¼ pounds (540g). Its crown-to-rump length is about 8½ inches (21cm).
Your baby now weighs about 1½ pounds (700g), and crown-to-rump length is about 8¾ inches (22cm).
Baby now weighs almost 2 pounds (.91kg). By this week, crown-to-rump length is about 9¼ inches (23cm).
This week marks the beginning of the third trimester. We’ll be adding total length of baby’s body from head to toe.
Your baby weighs nearly 2¼ pounds (1kg). Crown-to-rump length is close to 10 inches (25cm).
By this time, baby weighs about 2½ pounds (1.2kg). Crown-to-rump length is almost 10½ inches (26cm).
By week 30, baby weighs about 3 pounds (1.3kg). Its crown-to-rump length is a little over 10¾ inches (27cm), and total length is 15¾ inches (40cm).
Your baby weighs about 3⅓ pounds (1.5kg), and crown-to-rump length is 11¾ inches (28cm). Its total length is nearly 16 inches (41cm).
By this week, baby weighs almost 3¾ pounds (1.7kg). Crown-to-rump length is over 11½ inches (29cm), and total length is nearly 16¾ inches (42cm).
Your baby weighs about 4¼ pounds (1.9kg) by this week. Its crown-to- rump length is about 12 inches (30cm), and total length is nearly 17¼ inches (44cm).
Your baby weighs almost 4¾ pounds (2.15kg) by this week. Its crown- to-rump length is about 12¾ (32cm).
Your baby now weighs over 5¼ pounds (2.4kg). Crown-to-rump length is about 13¼ inches (33cm), and total length is 18¼ inches (46cm).
By this week, your baby weighs about 5¾ pounds (2.6kg). Its crown-to- rump length is over 13½ inches (34cm), and total length is 18⅔ inches (47cm).
Your baby weighs almost 6⅓ pounds (2.8kg). Crown-to-rump length is 14 inches (35cm).
At this time, your baby weighs about 6¾ pounds (3.1kg). Crown-to-rump length is still about 14 inches (35cm).
Your baby weighs about 7¼ pounds (3.3kg). Crown-to-rump length is about 14½ inches (36cm).
Your baby weighs about 7⅔ pounds (3.5kg). Its crown-to-rump length is about 14¾ to 15¼ inches (37 to 38cm).
